verdict.summary: You can build a public app that many merchants can install. A community report says App Store review typically takes 5–10 business days. Shopify does not state how long protected-customer-data review takes. The main hurdles are identity verification, install eligibility requirements, and production-ready review materials.
verdict.activeEffort: 2–4 days, mostly building OAuth, compliance webhooks, and review materials
verdict.waitTime: 5–10 business days (community-reported; App Store review only; data-protection timing is unstated)
verdict.mainGate: To list a public app, register for the Shopify App Store, complete identity verification, meet adoption eligibility requirements, and pass review.

recommendation.text: Choose public distribution. It lets unrelated merchants install the app. Choose expiring offline tokens for background agent work.

sources.quote: Building for many merchants : You'll use public distribution.
New public apps must use expiring offline access tokens for GraphQL Admin API requests. Include expiring=1 in your request. Shopify returns a refresh token alongside your access token.

scopeTiers.text: Read the merchant's product catalog. This is the cheapest typical read-only tier. App Store review still applies for public distribution.

sources.quote: Examples include `read_orders`/`write_orders`, `read_products`/`write_products`, `read_customers`/`write_customers`, fulfillment scopes, and discounts scopes as needed.
Public distribution also requires registering for the Shopify App Store, which has a one-time fee.

scopeTiers.need: Inspect products and answer catalog questions.

scopeTiers.text: Read orders without direct customer identifiers. Protected-customer-data review applies when the app reads customer data.

sources.quote: Examples include `read_orders`/`write_orders`, `read_products`/`write_products`, `read_customers`/`write_customers`, fulfillment scopes, and discounts scopes as needed.
Level 1 covers “Customer data excluding name, address, phone, and email fields”
Protected customer data is reviewed separately, and that review isn't scope approval.

scopeTiers.text: Read customer records with names, addresses, phones, or emails. Level 2 data-protection review applies.

sources.quote: Level 2 includes those direct identifiers and requires “Participate in data protection reviews.”
Shopify approves only the minimum data necessary for the stated app function.

scopeTiers.need: Answer customer-specific questions or prepare support work.

scopeTiers.text: Change products after merchant confirmation. Write access also includes read access. Review every action before saving it.

sources.quote: Any scope that writes a resource also grants read access, so request the write scope only when your app needs both.
Ask for confirmation before writing data. Propose the change and show your UI so that the merchant can review it before anything is saved.

scopeTiers.need: Create or update products from an approved agent proposal.

essentials.text: Request expiring offline tokens with expiring=1. Access tokens last one hour. Refresh tokens last 90 days and rotate on every refresh.

sources.quote: New public apps must use expiring offline access tokens for GraphQL Admin API requests. Include expiring=1 in your request. Shopify returns a refresh token alongside your access token.
Expiring offline access token 1 hour ( expires_in is 3600 )
Refresh token for an expiring offline access token 90 days ( refresh_token_expires_in is 7776000 ) when issued.
Every refresh returns a new access token and a new refresh token.

essentials.text: List every callback URL under [auth] redirect_urls. Each URL must exactly match the Dev Dashboard or TOML configuration.

sources.quote: must exactly match a redirect URI you've configured in the Dev Dashboard or your app's configuration TOML file.

essentials.text: Use a free development store to test the app before review. Development stores test incomplete apps before merchant installation.

sources.quote: Development stores can be used to test apps to ensure they're free of bugs or otherwise incomplete.

essentials.text: GraphQL capacity is per app and store. Standard stores restore 100 points each second. One query cannot exceed 1,000 points.

sources.quote: Standard 100 points/second, Advanced 200, Plus 1,000, and Commerce Components 2,000.
A single query may not exceed a cost of 1,000 points, regardless of plan limits.

essentials.text: Public App Store registration costs a one-time $19 USD per Partner account. Registration needs App development and Manage financials permissions.

sources.quote: To access the revenue share plan, you need to register with the Shopify App Store for a one-time fee of $19 USD per Partner account.
To register, you need the App development and Manage financials permissions .

essentials.text: Deploy production configuration with shopify app deploy. Published apps need 10 or more paid installs. Apps with zero installs after six months are removed.

sources.quote: For app configuration changes to take effect for all stores in production, you need to run the deploy command .
shopify app deploy
Each published app has 10 or more paid installs
Apps with zero installs after six months are automatically removed from the Shopify App Store.

sources.quote: Apps that are distributed through the Shopify App Store must subscribe to compliance webhooks.
1200 x 1200 pixels

detail.text: Create the app in the Dev Dashboard. Select public distribution before building. This choice cannot later change.

sources.quote: You can't change the distribution method after you select it.

detail.text: Register from a Partner account with App development and Manage financials permissions, and pay the one-time $19 USD fee per Partner account. Public App Store distribution also requires approval. New public-app submissions require identity verification and adoption eligibility.

sources.quote: To access the revenue share plan, you need to register with the Shopify App Store for a one-time fee of $19 USD per Partner account.
Only the Organization owner and Organization administrator roles include Manage financials .

detail.text: Run the Shopify CLI initializer in your project folder. Keep app configuration in shopify.app.toml.

sources.quote: shopify app init
shopify.app.toml

steps.title: Draft compliance configuration

detail.text: Paste these compliance webhook subscriptions into shopify.app.toml. Replace placeholders with your API version and HTTPS host. These topics support required data lifecycle handling.

sources.quote: Configure mandatory compliance topics (`customers/redact`, `customers/data_request`, `shop/redact`) in `shopify.app.toml`;
Apps that are distributed through the Shopify App Store must subscribe to compliance webhooks.

steps.output:
[webhooks]
api_version = "<API_VERSION>"

[[webhooks.subscriptions]]
topics = ["customers/redact"]
uri = "https://<APP_HOST>/webhooks/customers-redact"

[[webhooks.subscriptions]]
topics = ["customers/data_request"]
uri = "https://<APP_HOST>/webhooks/customers-data-request"

[[webhooks.subscriptions]]
topics = ["shop/redact"]
uri = "https://<APP_HOST>/webhooks/shop-redact"

detail.text: Add your HTTPS callback URL under [auth] redirect_urls. Request only needed scopes. Include expiring=1 during token exchange.

sources.quote: must exactly match a redirect URI you've configured in the Dev Dashboard or your app's configuration TOML file.
Include expiring=1 in your request.

detail.text: Implement authorization-code OAuth for each merchant's store. Validate state, callback HMAC, and the shop hostname. Store rotating tokens encrypted and refresh one store at a time.

sources.quote: Because they can't use ID tokens , they authenticate using the OAuth authorization code grant flow: redirect the merchant to Shopify, get their approval, and exchange a code for an access token.
Compare the state parameter to the nonce you stored in step 1. If they don't match, reject the request.
Every refresh returns a new access token and a new refresh token.

detail.text: Install the app in a free development store. Test install, token refresh, read actions, confirmed writes, and uninstall data deletion.

sources.quote: Development stores can be used to test apps to ensure they're free of bugs or otherwise incomplete.
delete all originals, copies and reproductions of the Merchant Data within 30 days

detail.text: Trigger each compliance webhook with Shopify CLI. Verify HTTPS webhook HMACs before processing requests.

sources.quote: Use the Shopify CLI webhook trigger command to test delivery.
HMAC verification is not required for cloud event bus deliveries.

detail.text: Complete identity verification before submitting a new public app.

sources.quote: Identity verification is now a required step for developers who submit new apps

steps.title: Draft reviewer instructions

detail.text: Submit the listing after automated checks pass. Add production URLs, icon, contacts, compliance webhooks, credentials, and the screencast. Request protected-customer-data review if your app reads customer data.

sources.quote: Public-App-Store review submission requires successful automated checks, production-ready URLs, compliance webhooks, icon, API contact details, listing, and emergency contact.
Protected customer data is reviewed separately, and that review isn't scope approval.

detail.text: Monitor the submission email for reviewer questions. Shopify assigns a reviewer after core requirements are met. The stated time is community reporting, not a service commitment.

sources.quote: typically takes 5-10 business days
a reviewer is assigned only after core requirements are met.

detail.text: Run shopify app deploy whenever configuration changes must take effect for stores in production. This releases your production configuration to stores.

sources.quote: For app configuration changes to take effect for all stores in production, you need to run the deploy command .
shopify app deploy

detail.text: Track paid installs. Each published app must have 10 or more paid installs; development stores and free-trial stores do not count. Delete merchant data after uninstall or a valid deletion request. Do not pool Shopify data to train or improve AI models without required consent.

sources.quote: Each published app has 10 or more paid installs
create, develop, train, fine tune, or improve any machine learning or artificial intelligence systems, models, or technologies, including large language models;
delete all originals, copies and reproductions of the Merchant Data within 30 days

gotchas.text: You cannot change public distribution later. Decide before creating the app.

sources.quote: You can't change the distribution method after you select it.

gotchas.text: Do not use online tokens for unattended agent work. They belong to one staff user and can expire after logout.

sources.quote: Online access tokens are tied to the staff member who opened your app
An online token expires after 24 hours or when the user logs out of the Shopify admin, whichever comes first.

gotchas.text: Do not train or improve a shared AI model with Shopify data without Shopify or relevant merchant consent.

sources.quote: except with Shopify’s written consent or, for Merchant Data/a specific Merchant Store, relevant merchant consent.

gotchas.text: Development stores and free trials do not count toward the paid-install adoption rule.

sources.quote: Development stores and stores on a free trial don't count.

whenBlocked.text: If registration is blocked, ask the organization owner for App development and Manage financials permissions.

sources.quote: To register, you need the App development and Manage financials permissions .

whenBlocked.text: If review pauses, fix the emailed core requirements and resubmit the production-ready app.

sources.quote: If core requirements block review, the app becomes Paused and Shopify emails required changes.

whenBlocked.text: If review exceeds its stated normal window, contact Shopify Partner Support and monitor the listing contact email.

sources.quote: contacting Shopify Partner Support after 10 business days.
The app submission email that you provided in the Contact information section of your listing form is where Shopify will email you during review.

whenBlocked.text: If Shopify denies customer-data access, reduce requested fields and explain the minimum required app function.

sources.quote: Shopify approves only the minimum data necessary for the stated app function.

uncertain: Shopify does not state a public duration for protected-customer-data review.
The notes provide no complete combined timeline for App Store review and data-protection review.
